hook.text: You checked the forecast 8 times. Never the One who sends it.

verses.text: “Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers.”

end.text: You checked the forecast 8 times. Never the One who sends it.

captions: The rent. The interview. The silence since.
5:04 p.m. The ring road. Red lights for a mile.
Then the radio goes quiet. The adhan of Maghrib.
Home. Cold water on your hands. Then your face.
Three rak'ahs. Then: Astaghfirullah. A hundred times.
The rain still falls. But now it sounds like mercy.

post.caption:
You checked the forecast 8 times today. Never the One who sends it. 🤍

“Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers.” (71:10-11)

Tonight, before Isha: Astaghfirullah, 100 times. Let the rain sound like mercy.
